stem:
Which graph best represents the solution set to this system of inequalities?


x + y < 1
x - y ≤ 2

options.label: A
options.text: Graph with shaded region in the top left quadrant bounded by dashed line x + y = 1 and solid line x - y = 2

options.label: B
options.text: Graph with shaded region in the bottom right quadrant bounded by dashed line x + y = 1 and solid line x - y = 2

options.label: C
options.text: Graph with shaded region in the top right quadrant bounded by solid line x + y = 1 and dashed line x - y = 2

options.label: D
options.text: Graph with shaded region in the bottom left quadrant bounded by solid line x + y = 1 and dashed line x - y = 2
